name: Global Jobs Indicators Database (JOIN)
licence: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0); confirm in the World Bank Data Catalog entry
attribution: Source: World Bank, Global Jobs Indicators Database (JOIN).
notes: API source=86 (api.worldbank.org/v2). 746 series incl. employment by ISCO major group x sex, education, age, urban/rural, and wages. Last updated 2023-05-22.

name: ILOSTAT
licence: To confirm on ILOSTAT terms of use (expected CC BY 4.0)
notes: Employment, earnings and hours by ISCO-08 occupation, sex, age, economic activity for most countries. SDMX API and bulk download; endpoints blocked this research environment, so confirm access from a normal network.

name: OECD Data Explorer (incl. OECD Employment Database)
licence: OECD terms (CC BY 4.0 for most datasets); confirm per dataset
notes: SDMX endpoint sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest (1,551 dataflows, 135 labour-related on 2026-11-10), incl. Africa's Development Dynamics employment by occupation, earnings by field of study, education and earnings.

name: International Standard Classification of Occupations (ISCO-08)
licence: ILO classification; free to use with attribution (confirm ILO copyright terms)
attribution: International Standard Classification of Occupations, ISCO-08, International Labour Organization.
notes: Imported via ESCO, which publishes the full ISCO-08 hierarchy with ILO group definitions. The ILO download links redirect to ILOSTAT, which blocked automated access.

name: ESCO: European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations
licence: Reuse for any purpose, free of charge, provided the source is acknowledged (Commission Decision 2011/833/EU); confirmed in the ESCO FAQ
notes: Imported via the ESCO Web Services API (ec.europa.eu/esco/api): the ISCO-08 hierarchy with definitions and ESCO occupations with descriptions, alternative titles and essential skills. Bulk CSV download requires an email form.

name: O*NET Database
publisher: US Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration
licence: CC BY 4.0 (confirmed in the O*NET Resource Center page metadata)
attribution: This page includes information from the O*NET 31.0 Database by the U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration (USDOL/ETA). Used under the CC BY 4.0 license. Career Proof has modified all or some of this information.
notes: Imported O*NET 31.0 (August 2026) text database, db_31_0_text.zip (13.2 MB), plus the official ESCO_to_ONET-SOC crosswalk. Tasks, skills, education, Job Zones and RIASEC interests. Also used (2026-11-10): Knowledge (importance by subject domain), Related Occupations (primary tiers) and Job Zone Reference, via scripts/ingest/onet_knowledge_build.py.

name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics data
licence: To confirm on UIS terms
notes: Education participation and attainment by country, coded with ISCED 2011 levels.

name: Global Jobs
licence: No reuse rights granted publicly; requires written permission
notes: International affairs, development and policy vacancies. Has an RSS feed and paid employer posting. Approach for a content partnership; do not scrape or republish without agreement.

name: InternationalJobs.com
licence: Copyright AboutJobs.com, Inc.; requires written permission
notes: Overseas and international vacancies; no public API or feed found. Partnership only.

name: CareerPlanner.com list of careers
licence: Not stated; treat as copyrighted
notes: Used only as a benchmark for breadth (about 1,388 careers listed). Not imported: we use the underlying public sources (O*NET, ESCO, ISCO-08) instead.

name: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS)
licence: Public domain (U.S. government work)
attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics.
notes: Imported 2025 OEWS national estimates via the BLS Public Data API v2 (registered key, stored in git-ignored .env.local): median annual pay and employment for 818 of 867 O*NET occupations (49 have no OEWS series at that code). The bls.gov website blocks automated access, so OOH pages are not crawled.

name: AfriQAN membership list
licence: All rights reserved (AAU); names of public bodies used as facts with citation
attribution: As listed by the African Quality Assurance Network (AfriQAN), Association of African Universities.
notes: 27 members; only national/regional regulators kept (14). Membership is not accreditation. Verify each body on its official site.

name: Research Organization Registry (ROR)
licence: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication)
attribution: Institution data from the Research Organization Registry (ROR), CC0.
notes: Imported ROR data dump v2.15 (2026-10-20, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23500708, 39.3 MB, MD5 verified): 30,326 active education institutions in 223 countries. Replaces univ.cc. Monthly releases on Zenodo.

name: World Higher Education Database (WHED)
publisher: International Association of Universities (IAU) with UNESCO
licence: Not open; www.whed.net robots.txt disallows AI crawlers (ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot) and sets ai-train=no, use=reference
notes: Authoritative list of recognised higher education institutions and credentials in about 200 countries. Not crawled. Request a data licence or partnership from IAU. UNESCO SDG4 knowledge hub page points to WHED.

name: DegreeAtlas institutions
licence: robots.txt disallows AI crawlers; ai-train=no, use=reference
notes: Not crawled. Covered by ROR and WHED.

name: African Union, Education directorate
licence: robots.txt disallows AI crawlers; ai-train=no, use=reference
notes: Policy context (CESA, continental qualifications framework). Not crawled; cite manually where relevant.

name: StudyMalaysia occupation search
licence: robots.txt disallows AI crawlers; ai-train=no, use=reference
notes: Not crawled. Malaysia overlay to come from MASCO (national classification) and official sources or a partnership.

name: World Certification Institute accredited organisations
licence: All rights reserved (WCI)
notes: Private credentialing body, not a government-recognised accreditor. Excluded so students are not misled about recognition.

name: univ.cc Universities Worldwide
licence: Not stated
notes: Private directory of about 7,900 institutions. Superseded by ROR (CC0).

name: Planit job profiles
licence: Not stated on the page; profiles are written content
notes: robots.txt allows crawling, but profile text is not reused. ESCO/O*NET cover occupations; a UK overlay can use official UK sources.

name: Ministry of Education and Sports, Uganda
licence: All rights reserved
attribution: Source: Ministry of Education and Sports, Uganda.
notes: Links to the authoritative bodies: UNEB (exams), UVTAB (TVET), NCHE (higher education), JAB admissions, scholarships notices. Uganda overlay should cite those bodies directly.

name: Official certification issuer pages
publisher: ACCA, CFA Institute, PMI, ISC2, CompTIA, Cisco, AWS, Microsoft, SHRM, CIPD, Google
licence: Facts only (not reproducing text); each issuer page linked per certification
attribution: Facts as stated on each issuer's official page, linked and dated.
notes: 11 certifications checked on 2026-11-10 (packages/reference-data/src/certifications.json). PMI read in a normal browser session; one page only. Pending: CIMA, CPA boards, CIPS (blocked), PRINCE2 (page moved), CEH.

name: UNESCO Global Convention on Higher Education
licence: Facts cited; UNESCO robots.txt allows ai-input for single pages, disallows AI crawling
notes: Adopted Nov 2019, in force 5 March 2023, 42 States Parties as of July 2026. Single page read, no crawling.

name: ISCED 2011 (International Standard Classification of Education)
publisher: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (with OECD, Eurostat)
licence: Classification facts cited
notes: Levels 0 to 8; tertiary = 5 to 8. Used on /admissions.

name: Certification list articles (IBT Careers, Indeed Career Guide)
licence: Copyrighted articles
notes: Used only to choose which certifications to cover; no text or facts taken.

name: Career programme organisations (Global Career Accelerator, Global Career Path US, Global Career Path Vietnam)
publisher: Podium Education; Global Career Path; Global Career Path (careerpathways.edu.vn)
licence: All rights reserved; no data published
notes: No structured data. Global Career Accelerator: US for-credit programme at 100+ universities. globalcareerpath.com: US/China executive search. careerpathways.edu.vn: Vietnam career guidance consultancy. Partnership prospects only.

name: UCAS Tariff tables (2027 entry cycle)
licence: Published reference tables; points values used as facts, attributed to UCAS
notes: Workbook tariff-may-2027_cycle-v1.1.4.1.xlsx; built by scripts/ingest/ucas_tariff_build.py. Supersedes the 2014 proposal PDF, whose IB values differ.

name: National admission bodies (explainers)
publisher: UAC (Australia), NTA (India); Parcoursup and EducationUSA pending
licence: Facts only, short attributed statements
notes: ibo.org, parcoursup.gouv.fr and enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr block automated access (bot verification); not bypassed. To confirm directly with the bodies.

name: Notes to Schools 2026/2027 (weighting system, programme requirements, 3-year cut-offs)
publisher: Ministry of Education & Sports, Uganda (published by Makerere University)
licence: Public government document; facts reused with attribution
attribution: Source: Ministry of Education & Sports, Notes to Schools 2026/2027.
notes: Parsed by scripts/ingest/ug_cutoffs_build.py; programme requirements hand-transcribed in ug-programme-requirements.json.

name: Makerere University admission cut-off points (government and private, 2025/2026)
licence: Public notices; facts reused with attribution
notes: PDF lists parsed with pdftotext -raw; values cross-checked against the Notes to Schools.

name: NCHE registered institutions and accredited programmes
publisher: National Council for Higher Education, Uganda
licence: Public register; facts reused with attribution
attribution: Source: National Council for Higher Education (NCHE), Uganda.
notes: robots.txt allows; data embedded in the page. Parsed by scripts/ingest/nche_build.py.

name: UNESCO IICBA Education Country Briefs (Africa)
publisher: UNESCO International Institute for Capacity Building in Africa
licence: UNESCO publication; short facts quoted with attribution
attribution: Source: UNESCO IICBA, Education Country Brief.
notes: Kenya brief (Jan 2024) read in a browser on 2026-11-10; plain HTTP requests get a bot-check page, not bypassed. Briefs exist for other African countries.

licence: Unknown; to request
notes: Blocked automated access (503 block page) on 2026-11-10; www.kuccps.ac.ke serves a bot-check script. Route: request a data file from KUCCPS.

name: UNESCO UIS Data API: education-system structure and tertiary enrolment
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0
attribution: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), https://api.uis.unesco.org/api/public. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Indicators 299905, 299932, 999975-999978, 400, GER.5T8 for 224 countries (Feb 2026 release). Script: scripts/ingest/uis-structure.mjs. Share-alike: the snapshot is redistributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: UNESCO UIS ISCED mappings (national programmes and minimum entry requirements)
licence: CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO (UIS terms)
attribution: Source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), ISCED mappings.
notes: 201 ISCED 2011 mapping files downloaded from download.uis.unesco.org (no robots.txt on that host; files listed on the UIS mapping page, read at the user's request). The www.uis.unesco.org website disallows ClaudeBot and was not crawled. Parsed by scripts/ingest/isced_build.py; names mapped by scripts/ingest/isced_names.mjs.

name: INQAAHE members database (quality assurance agencies)
publisher: International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education
licence: Public directory; names, countries and websites used as facts with attribution
notes: robots.txt allows all. 350 members fetched 2026-11-10 (1.5 s per page); 208 full members (QA agencies) in 94 countries kept. Scripts: scripts/ingest/inqaahe.mjs, inqaahe_build.mjs. Next: EQAR (bot check), APQN, ANQAHE member lists.
